hero_description.en: Your clients expect results and we provide the media and demographic intelligence to help you deliver. The  Media Techology Monitor (MTM) gives you precision targeting and pitch-winning insights.

problem_description.en: MTM gives your agency the competitive edge, transforming campaigns from speculation into pitches that guarantee client confidence

insight_1_title.en: More than 300,000 Canadians surveyed to date

insight_1_description.en: Our independent, nationally representative samples allow for detailed comparisons against your internal data and other sources. With the MTM, know where and how Canadians are engaged with an exhaustive array of media platforms and leave nothing up to chance.

insight_2_description.en: The MTM allows you to see Canada in high definition. Let your clients benefit from the surgical precision of being able to filter data by specific racialized groups, families, age groups, income brackets and more!

insight_2_chart_title.en: Learn about products/product reviews on YouTube

workflow_step_1_title.en: Understand the audience before the strategy takes shape.

workflow_step_1_description.en: Use MTM to profile the client's target audience before the brief is written. Know what they watch, what they stream, and where they spend time — so your strategic recommendation starts from evidence, not assumption.

workflow_step_2_title.en: Design your next pitch faster and smarter

workflow_step_2_description.en: Whether you’re planning a high-impact Out-of-Home campaign, a localized digital blitz, or a retail pop-up, we give you the power to defend your pitch every step of the way.

workflow_step_3_title.en: Turn the data into the slide that closes the room.

workflow_step_3_description.en: Export clean, presentation-ready charts and cross-tabs directly from the platform. When a client pushes back, you have the national dataset behind every number.

usecases_title.en: What you can do with MTM

usecases_description.en: Use the MTM to sharpen your pitches, validate plans and win more business — then apply the same thinking to your clients.
